name: ai-sdk
description: End-user agent skills for the Vercel AI SDK: build AI features from the installed package docs, and migrate apps from v6 to v7.

interface.shortDescription: Build and migrate apps with the Vercel AI SDK
interface.longDescription:
The AI SDK by Vercel is a TypeScript toolkit for building AI applications. This plugin gives coding agents two end-user skills from this repository.

use-ai-sdk answers questions about the AI SDK and helps build features — generateText, streamText, agents, tools, embeddings, providers, AI Gateway, and React hooks like useChat — by pointing at the installed ai package's bundled docs and source instead of stale training data. migrate-ai-sdk-v6-to-v7 walks through upgrading applications from AI SDK 6.x to 7.0 (API renames, instructions vs system, streaming, telemetry, and tool context).

Use it when working with the ai package or @ai-sdk/* packages, building agents or chat UIs, or upgrading across a major AI SDK release. Contributor skills under skills/ stay in the tree but are not part of this marketplace plugin.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a chatbot with the AI SDK and useChat
